axes.yDefinition: log10 cosmic star formation rate density of the zoom volume

selection.population: all star formation in the NewHorizon zoom volume
selection.warning: Total cosmic SFR density of the NewHorizon zoom (a small, non-volume-complete region) from z about 0.4 to 9, read from the vector paths of Dubois et al. 2021; the per-mass-bin curves, the cosmic-variance bar and the observational overlays are not extracted. The paper compares with Chabrier-IMF observations.

definitions.population: all galaxies in the zoom volume

provenance.citation: Dubois et al. 2021, A&A 651, A109 (arXiv:2009.10578), cosmic SFR density
provenance.figure: Cosmic SFR density and stellar density as a function of redshift
provenance.extractionMethod: vector path vertices from the figure PDF (PyMuPDF get_drawings), transformed through axes calibrated on labelled tick marks
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x: labels 0.0-1.0 of log10(1+z) from the lower panel of the same frame, snapped to ticks, converted exactly to z; y: decade labels 0.001-1.0 snapped to ticks (log10)

records.notes: Vector-path extraction; exact to PDF coordinate precision, so uncertainty is the plotted line, not marker tracing.
